cases.title: Default BTC training data preparation from an empty library
cases.precondition: Empty temporary library; recorded Binance monthly archives with CHECKSUM, Binance mirror REST pages and OKX history-candles pages for BTC/USDT 1d/4h/1h from 2017-08-17.
steps: Open the training service with no BTC data and observe the automatic preparation job and its progress.
Inject a network failure and a checksum mismatch in the middle batch, then retry.
Run an incremental re-sync after the fixtures advance by one period.
cases.expected: Each (instrument, timeframe) batch publishes atomically as its own dataset_version; the failed batch leaves no rows; the retry resumes from the watermark without duplicates; a default BTC/USDT run can be created after the 1d batch; the incremental sync adds only the new final bars.

cases.title: Stablecoin FX gaps no longer block crypto bar publication
cases.precondition: Recorded fixtures where USDT/USD is unavailable before 2021-06 (one provider errors, the other returns empty).
steps: Sync BINANCE:BTC/USDT from 2017-08-17.
Value a ledger position that needs USDT/USD inside the gap.
cases.expected: Crypto bars for the whole range are published; the FX gap is recorded as a valuation-only coverage gap; ledger valuation inside the gap stays unavailable with its reason; the sync is not reported as failed.

cases.title: missing_fee_asset_fx false positive and price-only candidate pool filtering
cases.precondition: Recorded fixtures with complete USDT/USD coverage for BINANCE:BTC/USDT and OKX:BTC/USDT in one sync, plus synthetic price-affecting issues on selected days.
steps: Sync both instruments in one job and inspect derived BTC/USD rates and quality issues.
Build the training candidate pool for each instrument.
cases.expected: Derived BTC/USD rates exist for every covered day and no missing_fee_asset_fx issue is recorded; every quality kind is classified affects_price or valuation_only; the pool excludes only segments with affects_price issues and BINANCE:BTC/USDT is eligible.

cases.title: Crypto 4h and 1h bars, UTC alignment and per-timeframe runs
cases.precondition: Prepared fixture library with BTC/USDT 1d/4h/1h and a US equity with daily bars only.
steps: Create 4h and 1h runs and advance across a UTC day boundary.
Request a 1h run for the US equity.
Replay both crypto runs.
cases.expected: Bars align to UTC hour and 4-hour boundaries; only final bars are visible; the run freezes its timeframe through pool, port, report and replay; the US equity intraday request is rejected with a clear reason.

cases.title: Higher-timeframe view aggregated only from truncated base bars
cases.precondition: 1h training run at a fixed seed; every bar after the clock overwritten with extreme sentinel values.
steps: Request 4h and 1d aggregated views at several clock positions, including mid-period.
Compare aggregates with hand calculation.
cases.expected: Aggregates match hand calculation from visible 1h bars only; the in-progress aggregate is flagged incomplete; no output contains a sentinel value.

cases.title: Quick orders fill at the visible close (m5-sim-2)
cases.precondition: m5-sim-2 run with a fee profile including notional rate, per-order minimum, slippage and spread; default buy ratio 1/10 and sell ratio 100%.
steps: Submit quick buy and quick sell at several bars, including a zero-volume bar.
Submit a quick buy that exceeds available cash.
cases.expected: Fill price equals the visible close with unfavourable spread and slippage and tick rounding; quantity follows the ratio floored to lot_size; fees and cash match hand calculation; zero-volume and insufficient-funds cases are rejected without partial fills; the run records the fill rule version.

cases.title: Modify order by price and quantity, including drag-to-modify
cases.precondition: Run with an open limit order, a stop order and an OCO bracket attached to an entry.
steps: Modify price and quantity through the service and by dragging the pending line in the headless UI.
Try to modify a locked order and a filled order.
cases.expected: Modification is an atomic cancel/replace effective from the next bar open; OCO and attached relations are kept; reservations are recomputed; the locked order does not move; modifying a filled order is rejected.

cases.title: Single undo, determinism and m4-sim-1 replay compatibility
cases.precondition: Command sequence with quick fills, submissions, cancels, modifications and undos; M4 gate fixture runs recorded with m4-sim-1.
steps: Undo after each undoable command; attempt an undo after advancing.
Replay the sequence in two processes, from a checkpoint and from scratch.
Replay the M4 fixture runs with the new code.
cases.expected: Undo restores cash, position, reservations and fees exactly and only back to the last advance; undo after advancing is rejected; all three replays have identical per-step hashes; M4 runs replay with their recorded hashes.

cases.title: Intraday DAY expiry and path rules on 4h/1h bars
cases.precondition: 1h and 4h runs with DAY and GTC orders submitted late in a UTC day; bars with gaps and same-bar double touches.
steps: Advance across the UTC day boundary.
Check fills against the O-L-H-C path rules.
cases.expected: DAY orders expire at the end of the UTC day of their eligible bar; GTC orders remain; gap and ambiguity handling match the daily rules and hand calculation.

cases.title: Practice account conservation, single active run and settlement
cases.precondition: Fresh library with automatic USD and USDT practice accounts; one M4 legacy run with independent cash.
steps: Deposit, withdraw, create, finish, abandon (restart) and delete runs in both currencies.
Try a second unfinished run on the same account and a withdrawal above available.
cases.expected: Each balance equals the sum of its entries and matches hand calculation; settlement uses equity at the last visible close; abandoned runs settle and cannot resume; deletion appends reversals only; the second run and the over-withdrawal are rejected (PRACTICE_ACCOUNT_BUSY / insufficient funds); the legacy run stays outside the balance; ledger_revision is unchanged.

cases.title: Training history and account analysis against hand calculation
cases.precondition: At least four settled runs including one abandoned, one zero-trade and one with zero losing trade groups, across 1d and 1h.
steps: Compute the account analysis and the history list.
Filter by market category and timeframe.
cases.expected: Equity curve, cumulative P/L, run and trade-group win rates, average win/loss ratio, profit factor, extreme ratio, expectation, fees, holding bars, plan execution rate and undo count match hand calculation; special states replace ordinary numbers; fewer than 20 trade groups shows the small-sample notice; hidden ranges stay hidden until reveal.

cases.title: Schema 6 migration, backup, export and delete
cases.precondition: v0.1.1 (schema 4) and M4 (schema 5) libraries with ledger data, notes and training runs.
steps: Open with the new build; force a migration failure once.
Export, back up, restore and preview deletion of a training run and of the library.
cases.expected: A consistent backup exists before migration; the forced failure rolls back and keeps the backup; all prior data survives; new tables are included in export, backup and delete previews; an older build refuses the schema 6 library.

cases.title: Headless training workbench workflow and misclick safety
cases.precondition: Headless GPUI test with a prepared fixture library and hidden mode on.
steps: Open training: the default BTC/USDT run starts; play continuously until a fill auto-pauses.
Quick buy/sell, drag a pending line, place a line order and confirm, draw Q/W/E lines, undo, clear drawings, finish, report, reveal.
Click and drag on the chart, press N/Space/Q/W/E with focus in an input.
cases.expected: The workflow completes with the expected service commands; no click, drag, playback or drawing key ever submits or fills an order; shortcuts are inert while an input has focus; markers, drawings, measurements and labels contain no real dates or names before reveal.

cases.title: CLI, UI and AI parity for runs and accounts
cases.precondition: One finished 1h run with quick fills, modifications and undos; practice account with transfers.
steps: Read the run, report and account through CLI JSON, UI DTOs and AI tools.
Call AI tools on an unfinished run.
cases.expected: Numbers, timeframe, fill rule and undo counts are identical across consumers; AI tools on the unfinished run are rejected; evidence references open the simulated orders and fills.

cases.title: Continuous playback and next-bar latency
cases.precondition: Release build; 1h run with 1,000 visible bars, default indicators, 20 drawings, 5 pending lines and trade markers.
steps: Play continuously at 150 ms per bar for 300 steps in a hidden window.
Record per-step durations and actual intervals.
cases.expected: Per-step p95 <= 100 ms and actual interval p95 <= 200 ms with hardware, sample count and p50/p95/p99 recorded; zero visible windows and unchanged foreground focus.

cases.title: Stage gate, quiet execution and regressions
steps: Run verify-stage --stage M5 --plan-version 1.0 --ui-smoke --ui-bench.
Run M1 v2.6, M2 v1.0, M3 v1.0 and M4 v1.0 regressions at the same fingerprint.
cases.expected: All required checks pass; the developer delta and delta-dev data and installs are untouched; no visible window or focus change.

cases.title: Dependency audit clean and vulnerable archive/XML crates upgraded
cases.precondition: Network access to the crates.io index and OSV; zip and quick-xml upgraded to fixed releases at least 7 days old.
steps: Run python scripts/deps.py --audit and python scripts/deps.py before handoff.
Extract crafted archives whose entry path escapes the target directory and whose symlink points outside it.

Run the import, export, backup/restore, bundle, installer and packaging tests, and verify the published v0.1.1 signature and update manifest with the built-in public key after the signing crates change.
cases.expected: The audit reports status passed (informational unmaintained advisories are only listed); both crafted archives are rejected without writing outside the target; all listed tests pass; v0.1.1 still verifies. A reverted upgrade is recorded in the stage report with the attempted version, failing command and review condition.

cases.title: Live public BTC data preparation
cases.precondition: Network access to data.binance.vision, data-api.binance.vision and www.okx.com; temporary library only.
steps: Run verify-stage --stage M5 --plan-version 1.0 --live-data.
Record earliest dates, row counts, duration, database growth and cross-source divergence per timeframe.
cases.expected: Real public sources produce eligible BTC/USDT 1d/4h/1h training data within the M5-K01 limits, or the failure is recorded with its cause; results are declared separately from recorded fixtures.

cases.title: Training workbench hands-on experience
cases.precondition: Latest delta-dev build installed after the merge to main; steps in needs-user issue #21 (H-06).
steps: Start the default BTC game, play continuously, trade with quick buttons and line orders, drag-modify, undo, draw, finish and reveal.
Transfer funds, open training history and account analysis.
cases.expected: The person records whether any misclick filled an order, whether playback and markers are readable, and whether account numbers make sense, with the build source_fingerprint.
